info.title: Tickwire configuration control API
info.description: Design contract; not an implemented service. mTLS identifies callers; role bindings authorize every resource and target. Errors never contain secret bytes. Whole revisions use strong ETag/If-Match and caller-scoped idempotency. Field-level update classes are defined in specs/implementation/config-candidate.md; file durability is defined in specs/implementation/config-materializer.md. Plan content preparation is described in specs/implementation/config-planning.md.

post.description: Additional risk-admin or cluster-admin roles are mandatory when required by the plan. 202 means durably admitted, not applied. Every successful admission has a durable operation and idempotency mapping. Global revision/hash is shared; each target has its own expected projection hash/policy revision. Runtime and file receipts must match that target projection, not the hashes of other targets. Succeeded requires runtime and effective-file durable receipts at the same revision/hash for every frozen target. No per-order control-plane call is introduced.

get.description: HTTP 200 reports observed state, not an implicit global success. complete=true only when all target facts match current desired and none are unavailable or drifted. Results include observation timestamps; no cross-process instantaneous snapshot is promised. Scoped readers receive authorized targets only; complete is computed over the full internal delivery set, never just the visible subset.

get.description: HTTP 200 means the operation resource was read. Only state=Succeeded claims successful application; Committed and RuntimeApplied are insufficient. Historical success records remain immutable after later crashes or revisions. Scoped views omit unauthorized delivery targets; delivery_scope reports opaque global counts/hash, and Succeeded always refers to the full internal target set.

post.description: Only Stalled operations can resume. Recheck policy, target generation and dependency facts; apply already-matching targets idempotently. Planned successor bindings remain within the original target membership. Unplanned identity or generation changes require a new plan. Resume never blindly repeats economic actions.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact strong ETag from GET desired. Wildcards and weak ETags are rejected.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-scoped UUID. Reuse with the same canonical request returns the same resource; changed content returns 409.

x-role-semantics: x-required-roles lists baseline roles. Plan.required_roles is an additional all-of requirement, scoped over every affected account; cluster-admin is not an implicit risk-admin. Viewer access is included for other authorized roles.
x-idempotency: Bind principal, endpoint, canonical request hash and base If-Match. Persist resource mapping before returning 201/202; same-key retry returns original resource despite subsequently stale If-Match. Retain mappings at least 90 days in reference profile; audit IDs and revision history remain non-reusable.
